newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were steady in late trading on Friday, with buying interest remaining soft on a lack of fresh factors, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,415-20 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but trades were also heard at 1,410 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,170 rupiah/kg.
"The market was slow moving today, but a bit better than yesterday," one trader said. "Prices are likely to remain in this range next week, but I think they will improve gradually."
Traders said export prices remained attractive due in part to the weakening of the Indonesian currency against the U.S. dollar, and that local supply was expected to tighten.
"Export prices are better, and with increased exports local supply will tighten over the next couple of months," one said. "But at the moment, buyers are not too concerned of this."

Data from Belawan Port showed that the KM Philipos will leave the North Sumatran port on Monday for Amsterdam with 7,600 tonnes of palm kernel expeller. The MT Pangeran will leave for Tanjung Priok in Jakarta on Friday with 1,600 tonnes of olein.
